Lions vs Packers Betting History

Every Detroit Lions vs Green Bay Packers game since the 1966 season: 121 meetings with the final score, the closing point spread, the closing total and how each game graded against both. The Packers lead the series 68-49-4. Against the spread the Lions are 62-57-2 (Packers 57-62-2), the over is 55-40, and the Packers have outscored the Lions by 1.9 points a game.
